name: large_perceptual
_purpose: For a GPU with more than 6 GB and tensor cores. Combines the two things measured to matter: ~3x the capacity (4.4M vs 1.37M parameters) and a perceptual LPIPS term in the loss, which is where the base model is weakest.
_amp_note: amp:true assumes tensor cores. BENCHMARK IT: on a GTX 16-series card fp16 was measured 5x SLOWER than fp32. Run --benchmark with true and with false, keep the faster.
_ship_rule: Compare against the current model on BOTH evaluate.py and ood_check.py, and on inference speed. KLA scores throughput too, so a 3x larger model must earn its cost.
